jobs.title: Sales Associate / Retail Sales Executive
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Apply for Lenskart Jobs 2027: Sales Associate openings for freshers & graduates in Gurgaon. CTC ₹2.5-3 LPA (₹18k/month in-hand). Apply now on the official portal!

About Lenskart

Founded in 2010 by Peyush Bansal, Lenskart has grown from a D2C startup into a global eyewear unicorn. Serving over 40 million customers globally, Lenskart operates 1,500+ omnichannel stores across 175+ cities in India, Singapore, Dubai, and Saudi Arabia.

Driven by its core purpose of #DoMoreBeMore, Lenskart manages end-to-end optical manufacturing and retail operations. The company operates one of the world’s most automated eyewear manufacturing plants in Bhiwadi, Rajasthan, shipping an eyewear unit every 2.5 seconds. Joining Lenskart offers young professionals structured career progression within a rapidly scaling corporate ecosystem.

Key Highlights of Lenskart Jobs 2027

The key details regarding the Lenskart sales associate job drive are summarized below:

Vacancy & Role Details

Lenskart is filling 50 Sales Associate seats to support its retail outlet expansion across Gurgaon.

Job Roles & Responsibilities of Lenskart Jobs 2027

Customer Consultation: Welcome walk-in customers and assist them in selecting optical frames, sunglasses, and lens options based on their style preferences and vision needs.

Product Assistance: Explain product features, coating options, index benefits, and ongoing store offers clearly.

Store Operations & Merchandising: Maintain visual merchandising standards, hygiene, frame cleaning, and inventory display according to Lenskart SOPs.

POS & Billing Management: Handle the point-of-sale (POS) terminal, process customer transactions accurately, and manage order placements.

Target Achievement: Work toward achieving monthly store sales targets, return metrics, and customer satisfaction scores.

Eligibility Criteria

Candidates must fulfill the following criteria before applying for Lenskart hiring freshers 2027:

Educational Qualification

Graduates: Any Graduate degree (B.A., B.Com, B.Sc, BBA, BCA, B.Tech, etc.) — Freshers are fully eligible.

12th Pass: Candidates who have completed 10+2 / Intermediate are eligible if they possess 1–4 years of experience in retail sales or customer services.

Age Limit & Skill Requirements

Age Limit: Candidates must be at least 18 years of age at the time of joining.

Immediate Joiner: Applicants must be ready to join immediately upon selection.

Key Skills: Strong verbal communication, customer-centric attitude, basic computer proficiency, visual merchandising awareness, and teamwork skills.

Stipend, Salary & Employee Benefits

Official Compensation Package

Gross CTC: ₹2.5 LPA to ₹3.0 LPA

In-Hand Fixed Salary: Approximately ₹18,000 per month

Sales Incentives: Additional monthly performance-linked incentives based on target achievements.

Lenskart Academy Training Benefits

Selected candidates participate in a 20-day intensive functional training program at Lenskart Academy, Bhiwadi.

Salary Starts from Day 1: Pay commences from the first day of training at the Bhiwadi facility.

Skill Development: Training covers retail management principles, optical frame technicalities, customer service techniques, POS software operation, and basic vision checking guidance.
